description: This file defines the 'SendingContext' class, which encapsulates context information for publishing a message to a generic target within the Eclipse Ditto connectivity messaging framework. It includes fields for message signals, messages, targets, monitors, and auto-acknowledgment handling, along with a builder for constructing instances.

classes.name: SendingContext
classes.description: Immutable class representing context information for sending a message, including signals, message, target, monitors, and acknowledgment logic.

classes.name: SendingContext.Builder
classes.description: A mutable builder class for constructing instances of SendingContext with a fluent API.

methods.name: SendingContext.newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance for constructing SendingContext objects.

methods.name: SendingContext.getMappedOutboundSignal
methods.description: Retrieves the mapped outbound signal associated with this context.

methods.name: SendingContext.getExternalMessage
methods.description: Returns the external message associated with this context.

methods.name: SendingContext.getGenericTarget
methods.description: Returns the target to which the message is being sent.

methods.name: SendingContext.getPublishedMonitor
methods.description: Returns the monitor tracking the publication status.

methods.name: SendingContext.getAcknowledgedMonitor
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the acknowledgment monitor if set.

methods.name: SendingContext.getDroppedMonitor
methods.description: Returns the monitor tracking dropped messages.

methods.name: SendingContext.getAutoAckTarget
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the auto-acknowledgment target if set.

methods.name: SendingContext.shouldAcknowledge
methods.description: Determines if this context requires acknowledgment, based on auto-ack target and acknowledged monitor.

methods.name: SendingContext.setExternalMessage
methods.description: Returns a new SendingContext with an updated external message.
